The main takeaway from our work is that
the vegetation and environmental history of Estonia is not uniform, but varies from place to place, depending on the local environmental conditions.

the Solova Bog sequence is a very valuable archive of late glacial and early Holocene vegetation history in Estonia and in northern Europe, and it is an important reference site for the study of the early postglacial vegetation dynamics in the Baltic Sea region.

the Solova sequence provides a valuable addition to the existing knowledge of the deglaciated areas of Estonia, which is important for the reconstruction of the timing of the deglacation and the early postglacial history in the region.
